method: Reviewed all 65 offensive mappings against their lesson objectives. Fetched fresh public watch-page player metadata and publisher descriptions for all 31 existing source videos on 2026-10-02. Named instructional chapters are retained with exact boundaries; title-only Shorts, raw cutups and misaligned examples are removed. Six complete short teaching clips have detailed publisher explanations supporting their scope; no claim of manually watching them is made. Caption endpoints returned no usable transcript. Subsequent YouTube requests returned 429 and were stopped. Watch-page OK/playableInEmbed flags are metadata evidence only, not proof that a third-party iframe will play; domain playback failures are tracked separately. All four gap entries now use directly inspected, timestamped whiteboard instruction. The replacement played in an HTTPS Firebase preview; sampled labels and burned-in captions establish the individual gap boundaries.
